notes.title: May 6th Update Patch
notes.notes:
Increased the number of containers in Map 7.
Enhanced loot quantities from select containers in Map 7.
Armed merchant escorts in Map 7 with defensive weaponry, enabling them to protect both themselves and traders.

notes.title: Major Update — New Map, New Monsters
notes.notes:
A novel locale—Eerie Ruins coming！Presenting extreme peril with densely clustered adversaries. Players are advised to equip themselves thoroughly before venturing into this treacherous domain.
Accompanying the map's debut, several innovative items and crafting formulae shall be introduced, awaiting your discovery.
New side quests and randomized missions will be integrated into the uncharted territory.
Fresh horrors emerge: the Necrotic Slug, alongside a formidable new boss—the Omen's Ovum.
A novel merchant NPC will inhabit the map, their wares ripe for exploration.
Additional armor sets and helmets shall augment your defensive arsenal.
Concurrently, numerous known bugs shall be rectified.

notes.title: No Escape From Madness - April 10th Update Note
notes.notes:
After days of intensive optimization, we've implemented these changes:

[list]
[*][b]Combat System Overhaul:[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Completely redesigned damage calculation:
    [list]
    [*]Direct damage only occurs when: [Armor Durability ≥ 0] AND [Bullet Penetration ≥ Armor Level]
    [*]Otherwise, armor durability is depleted first
    [/list]
  [*]Added tiered armor damage reduction: Higher level armor provides better protection
  [*]New damage display feature shows weapon damage output
  [/list]

[*][b]Loot & Inventory Improvements:[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Revised item drop distribution - materials now spawn more consistently
  [*]Increased stack limits for most craftable items
  [/list]

[*][b]Map Fixes:[/b]
  [list]
  [*]Fixed collision issues in Island map (reduced invisible walls)
  [*]Adjusted Snow Mountain statue interaction (no more repeated triggers)
  [/list]
[/list]

[h2][color=#FF0000]Important Notice[/color][/h2]
This update contains significant system changes. While thoroughly tested, new bugs may emerge. 
Please report any issues through our official channels - we'll respond promptly!

[quote]"Search for better armor - it matters now more than ever!"[/quote]

notes.title: No Escape From Madness - April 5th Optimization Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hotfix Update Based on Your Feedback[/h1]

After carefully reviewing player feedback, we've implemented immediate adjustments:

[olist]
[*] Looting time significantly reduced: 2.5s → 1s (60% faster!)
[*] Enemy AI rebalanced: No more "Flash-like" sprinting movements
[*] Experience improved: Fresh saves now begin with a fully-equipped bonus character (doesn't replace existing characters)
[*] Exploration made more forgiving: First-time map deaths now grant one free revival
[*] Zombie audio optimized: Temporary fix prevents repetitive moaning in large areas (full SFX remake coming later)
[/olist]

We're currently planning comprehensive visual, audio, and character design overhauls - see our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/3264820/announcements/detail/498317776823255849]previous announcement[/url] for preliminary details.

Help shape our next major update!
We're actively collecting detailed feedback on all platforms where you can reach us.

Thank you for your continued support as we keep improving the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266628/ee550844b284f7c34215a885cb7e92198955880a.png[/img]

notes.title: Overview of Official Version Updates
notes.notes:
[center][h1]Official Version Release Notes[/h1][/center]

[center][b]Compared to the previous version, we've made the following updates:[/b][/center]

[olist]
[*][b]Completely revamped visual effects[/b] - Map brightness now changes dynamically based on in-game time
[*][b]Added two new weapons[/b] - G36C assault rifle and AWP bolt-action rifle
[*][b]Fixed enemy corpse overlapping[/b] - Now you can scroll wheel to select which corpse to loot
[*][b]Adjusted looting speed[/b] - Items can now be searched slightly faster
[*][b]Added price display[/b] - Looted items now show their purchase value for better decision making
[*][b]New large backpack[/b] - 9×10 grid size (goodbye inventory space problems!)
[*][b]New expandable containers[/b] - Two free ones given at game start for your looting pleasure
[*][b]Ammo availability[/b] - All bullet types now available in stores
[*][b]Formless Child spawn warning[/b] - Countdown timer added before high-insight spawns (no more jump scares!)
[*][b]Hakka cuisine implemented![/b] - Enjoy delicious Cthulhu-themed food (may kill you, but worth it!)
[*][b]Container crafting system[/b] - Those weird high-insight materials might be valuable crafting components
[*][b]And many more secrets[/b] - Waiting for you to discover!
[/olist]

[i]We hope you enjoy the new version![/i]
[i]Sincerly Game Producer ----- Qin[/i]

notes.title: March 19 Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
The contents of this update are as follows:

Multiple backpacks will now open in sequence and be arranged separately, no longer overlapping with each other.
The size of an opened backpack now matches its actual size, eliminating any blank space occupation.
Adjusted the algorithm for selling items. For cases with nested backpacks, the price of items on every layer will now be calculated, instead of only accounting for the value of the first layer.
Adjusted some unreasonable fonts and item prices.

notes.title: 17.march Demo update
notes.notes:
In this update, we mainly completed the following tasks:

Fixed the issue where a large purchase quantity in the store would exceed the game's maximum value, causing a negative amount.
Fixed the bug where "Reloading" was displayed when performing other actions while drinking water.
The custom key settings page now allows exiting by pressing ESC.
Fixed the bug where some slots in the warehouse were occupied by empty space after quickly switching equipment.
Adjusted the display of some fonts.
Now, after finishing a full magazine, the agent will reload automatically (please test this).
Fixed the bug where pressing F to force search was possible after opening the inventory in the game.
You can now exit the Save/Buy Preset Scheme page by pressing ESC.
